onboarding.subtitle: To get started, choose a transcription model

parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2.name: Parakeet V2
parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2.description: English only. The best model for English speakers.

moonshine-base.name: Moonshine Base
moonshine-base.description: Very fast, English only. Handles accents well.

moonshine-small-streaming-en.name: Moonshine V2 Small
moonshine-small-streaming-en.description: Fast, English only. Good balance of speed and accuracy.

breeze-asr.name: Breeze ASR
breeze-asr.description: Optimized for Taiwanese Mandarin. Code-switching support.

sense-voice-int8.name: SenseVoice
sense-voice-int8.description: Very fast. Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Cantonese.

gigaam-v3-e2e-ctc.name: GigaAM v3
gigaam-v3-e2e-ctc.description: Russian speech recognition. Fast and accurate.

canary-180m-flash.name: Canary 180M Flash
canary-180m-flash.description: Very fast. English, German, Spanish, French. Supports translation.

canary-1b-v2.name: Canary 1B v2
canary-1b-v2.description: Accurate multilingual. 25 European languages. Supports translation.

permissions.title: Permissions Required
permissions.description: Handy needs a couple of permissions to work properly.

microphone.title: Microphone Access
microphone.description: Required to hear your voice for transcription.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Access
accessibility.description: Required to type transcribed text into your applications.

errors.checkFailed: Failed to check permissions. Please try again.
errors.requestFailed: Failed to request permission. Please try again.

modelSettings.title: {{model}} Settings
modelSettings.noSettingsNeeded: This model works automatically with no configuration needed.

shortcut.title: Handy Shortcuts
shortcut.description: Configure keyboard shortcuts to trigger speech-to-text recording

transcribe.name: Transcribe Shortcut
transcribe.description: The keyboard shortcut to record and transcribe your voice.

cancel.name: Cancel Shortcut
cancel.description: The keyboard shortcut to cancel the current recording.

transcribe_with_post_process.name: Post-Processing Hotkey
transcribe_with_post_process.description: Optional: A dedicated hotkey that always applies AI post-processing to your transcription.

errors.reset: Failed to reset shortcut to original value

language.title: Language
language.description: Select the language for speech recognition. Auto will automatically determine the language, while selecting a specific language can improve accuracy for that language.
language.descriptionUnsupported: Parakeet model automatically detects the language. No manual selection is needed.

pushToTalk.label: Push To Talk
pushToTalk.description: Hold to record, release to stop

models.title: Transcription Models
models.description: Select a transcription model or download additional models. Different models offer varying levels of accuracy and speed.
models.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete {{modelName}}? You will need to download it again to use it.
models.deleteActiveConfirm: {{modelName}} is your active model. Deleting it will stop transcriptions until you select a new model. Are you sure?

audioFeedback.label: Audio Feedback
audioFeedback.description: Play sound when recording starts and stops

outputDevice.title: Output Device
outputDevice.description: Select your preferred audio output device for feedback sounds

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Adjust the volume of audio feedback sounds

experimentalToggle.label: Experimental Features
experimentalToggle.description: Enable experimental features that are still in development.

lazyStreamClose.label: Keep Mic Open Between Transcriptions
lazyStreamClose.description: Keeps the microphone stream open for 30 seconds after recording stops, reducing latency for back-to-back transcriptions. May degrade Bluetooth audio quality while active.

whisper.title: Whisper Acceleration
whisper.description: Hardware acceleration for Whisper models. Auto uses GPU if available (Metal on macOS, Vulkan on Windows/Linux).

ort.title: ONNX Acceleration
ort.description: Hardware acceleration for ONNX models (Parakeet, Canary, Moonshine, etc.). DirectML on Windows is experimental. Models may fail to transcribe.

gpuDevice.title: GPU Device
gpuDevice.description: Select which GPU to use for Whisper inference. Auto picks the dedicated GPU.

startHidden.label: Start Hidden
startHidden.description: Launch to system tray without opening the window.

autostart.label: Launch on Startup
autostart.description: Automatically start Handy when you log in to your computer.

showTrayIcon.label: Show Tray Icon
showTrayIcon.description: Display the Handy icon in the system tray.

overlay.title: Overlay Position
overlay.description: Display visual feedback overlay during recording and transcription. On Linux 'None' is recommended.

pasteMethod.title: Paste Method
pasteMethod.description: Choose how text is inserted. Direct: simulates typing via system input. None: skips paste, only updates history/clipboard.

typingTool.title: Typing Tool
typingTool.description: Choose which Linux typing tool to use for Direct paste method. Auto will automatically detect and use the best available tool for your system.

clipboardHandling.title: Clipboard Handling
clipboardHandling.description: Don't Modify Clipboard preserves your current clipboard contents after transcription. Copy to Clipboard leaves the transcription result in your clipboard after pasting.

autoSubmit.title: Auto Submit
autoSubmit.description: Automatically send the selected key combination after text insertion. Cmd+Enter applies on macOS, while Windows/Linux use Super+Enter.

translateToEnglish.label: Translate to English
translateToEnglish.description: Automatically translate speech from other languages to English during transcription.
translateToEnglish.descriptionUnsupported: Translation is not supported by the {{model}} model.

modelUnload.title: Idle Release Model
modelUnload.description: Automatically free GPU/CPU memory when the model hasn't been used for the specified time (release = unload)

customWords.title: Custom Words
customWords.description: Add words that are often misheard or misspelled during transcription. The system will automatically correct similar-sounding words to match your list.

pipeline.title: Runtime Pipeline (Model vs APP Script)
pipeline.description: Shows where model inference happens and where local APP scripts run. APP scripts include built-in conservative fallback and your editable external scripts.

transcriptionModel.title: Transcription Model
transcriptionModel.description: Qwen/Whisper transcribes speech into raw text.

asrAppScript.title: APP Processing Script (After Transcription)
asrAppScript.description: Built-in fallback + optional external script for ASR-stage cleanup.

postProcessModel.title: Post-Processing Model
postProcessModel.description: Applies system prompt, user prompt template, and generation params.

llmAppScript.title: APP Processing Script (After Post-Process Model)
llmAppScript.description: Built-in fallback + optional external script for final cleanup.

asr.title: Step 3 · APP Processing Script (After Transcription)
asr.description: Configure script path, import/export, and test for the post-transcription APP stage.

llm.title: Step 5 · APP Processing Script (After Post-Process Model)
llm.description: Configure script path, import/export, and test for the final APP stage after post-processing model.

outputStage.title: Step 6 · Final Output
outputStage.description: Output enters paste/history pipeline after model + APP processing stages.
outputStage.noteDescription: This stage is primarily controlled by output and history settings.
outputStage.note: If you need to adjust insertion behavior, clipboard handling, or history retention, use Advanced/History settings.

adaptiveIdle.title: Idle Release Strategy (Adaptive)
adaptiveIdle.description: Extends idle release windows during frequent usage to reduce hot/cold thrashing, then gradually falls back after long inactivity.
adaptiveIdle.toggleDescription: Adjusts release thresholds using recent usage tiers (30/60 min) to reduce repeated release-and-warmup cycles.
adaptiveIdle.transcriptionHint: Transcription model: adaptive extension is applied on top of the base idle-release timeout (about 30/60 min tiers).
adaptiveIdle.postProcessHint: Post-processing model: uses the same adaptive tiering and also unloads automatically when local post-processing is not active.

keepWarm.toggleDescription: Within a recent activity window, periodically refreshes hot state to reduce cold starts. Disable to rely only on idle release.
keepWarm.paramsDescription: Keep-alive only runs while usage is still considered recent. Outside the window, normal idle release applies.

interval.label: Keep-alive interval (sec)
interval.hint: How often to send a keep-alive heartbeat. Range: 60-3600.

activeWindow.label: Recent activity window (min)
activeWindow.hint: Keep-alive runs only if real usage happened within this window. Range: 5-240.

preloadConflict.title: Preload vs Immediate Release
preloadConflict.description: You selected "Immediately" for release timeout, so startup preload is no longer meaningful and related controls are disabled.
preloadConflict.transcriptionHint: Transcription model: falls back to on-trigger load instead of startup residency.
preloadConflict.postProcessHint: Post-processing model: falls back to on-trigger warmup instead of startup residency.

qwenTranscription.title: Model Stage: Qwen Transcription Runtime (2 models)
qwenTranscription.description: Runtime performance path for Qwen3-ASR-0.6B and 1.7B.
qwenTranscription.hint: Prefers compatible system Python (>=3.11); falls back to bundled uv + .venv automatically. Python package index uses mirror-first fallback.

strategy.title: Startup Load Strategy
strategy.description: Controls whether Qwen transcription and post-processing model loads run in parallel or serially on app startup.

qwen3Preload.label: Load Qwen3 transcription on startup
qwen3Preload.description: When enabled, Handy loads the currently selected Qwen3 transcription model on launch to reduce first-run latency.

qwen3Warmup.label: Run quick warmup after load
qwen3Warmup.description: Enabled by default. Runs one short warmup inference after each cold reload of the transcription model to reduce first-transcription delay.

qwen35Preload.label: Load Qwen3.5 post-processing on startup
qwen35Preload.description: When enabled, Handy preloads the selected local Qwen3.5 post-processing model at startup (local provider only).

qwen35Warmup.label: Run quick warmup after load
qwen35Warmup.description: Enabled by default. Runs one short warmup inference after each cold reload of the post-processing model to reduce first-request delay.

startupTiming.title: Load Timing
startupTiming.description: Tune startup delay before loading to avoid a CPU spike right after app launch.

qwen3Delay.label: Qwen3 load delay (ms)
qwen3Delay.hint: 0 means immediate load. Increase slightly to reduce startup stutter. Range: 0-15000.

qwen35Delay.label: Qwen3.5 load delay (ms)
qwen35Delay.hint: 0 means immediate load. Increase to move post-processing load deeper into background startup. Range: 0-15000.

runtime.title: Runtime Parallelism
runtime.description: Caps Python/BLAS thread counts. 0 means auto; higher values can improve throughput but use more CPU.

qwen3Threads.label: Qwen3 max threads (0-16)
qwen3Threads.hint: Thread cap for Qwen3 transcription runtime. 2-6 is usually enough on laptops.

qwen35Threads.label: Qwen3.5 max threads (0-16)
qwen35Threads.hint: Thread cap for local post-processing runtime. Lower values can be more stable for long prompts.

timeouts.title: Timeout Protection
timeouts.description: Limits startup and inference wait time to avoid hard stalls.

qwen3Ready.label: Qwen3 startup ready timeout (sec)
qwen3Ready.hint: Maximum wait for Qwen3 server READY. Range: 10-120.

qwen35Startup.label: Qwen3.5 startup ready timeout (sec)
qwen35Startup.hint: Maximum wait for local post-processing server READY. Range: 20-300.

qwen35Inference.label: Qwen3.5 inference timeout (sec)
qwen35Inference.hint: Maximum wait for one post-processing response. Range: 5-180.

localModel.title: Local Post-Process Model
localModel.description: Download and switch local post-processing models. Clicking 'Use' will also switch provider to local.

systemPrompt.title: System Prompt
systemPrompt.description: Defines global behavior constraints for post-processing. Keep it strict: output only final text, no reasoning/explanations.
systemPrompt.placeholder: You are a strict transcription post-processor. Output final text only, no explanations, no <think> tags.

localQuality.title: Local Parameter Profile
localQuality.description: Use one of three preset profiles, or switch to Custom by editing any advanced parameter.
localQuality.balancedOnly: Preset profiles are available below. Any manual parameter edit will automatically switch to Custom.
localQuality.customAutoHint: Tip: changing any parameter below will auto-switch this profile to Custom.

advancedLocal.title: Advanced Local Params
advancedLocal.description: Directly tune local post-processing generation parameters. Changes apply immediately after save.
advancedLocal.singlePresetNotice: Only one local preset is kept in this build. Tune the parameters below directly.
advancedLocal.maxTokensHint: Maximum output length per post-processing run. Too small may truncate output; too large is usually slower.
advancedLocal.temperatureHint: Controls randomness. Lower is more deterministic; higher is more diverse. For translation, 0.0~0.2 is usually best.
advancedLocal.topPHint: Nucleus sampling range. Lower is more conservative; higher is more flexible. Tune with temperature together.
advancedLocal.repetitionPenaltyHint: Reduces repetitive output. Higher values suppress repetition more, but can hurt fluency if too high.
advancedLocal.repetitionContextSizeHint: Context window size used for repetition checks. Larger values check repetition over a wider span.
advancedLocal.localOnlyHint: Current provider is not local. These parameters take effect when you switch back to local provider.

appleIntelligence.title: Apple Intelligence
appleIntelligence.description: Runs fully on-device. No API key or network access is required.
appleIntelligence.requirements: Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS Tahoe (26.0) or later. Apple Intelligence must be enabled in System Settings.
appleIntelligence.unavailable: Apple Intelligence is not available on this device. Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS Tahoe (26.0) or later with Apple Intelligence enabled in System Settings.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: API base URL for the selected provider. Only the custom provider can be edited.

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: API key for the selected provider.

model.title: Model
model.descriptionApple: Provide an optional numeric token limit or keep the default on-device preset.
model.descriptionCustom: Provide the model identifier expected by your custom endpoint.
model.descriptionDefault: Choose a model exposed by the selected provider.

enabled.title: Enable APP Processing Scripts
enabled.description: Run local APP processing scripts in configured stages. Disabled means script stages are skipped.

postAsrPath.title: APP Script Path: After Transcription
postAsrPath.description: Runs after transcription output is cleaned by baseline filters. Leave empty to skip this APP stage.

postLlmPath.title: APP Script Path: After Post-Process Model
postLlmPath.description: Runs after the post-processing model returns text. Leave empty to skip this APP stage.

timeout.title: Script Timeout (ms)
timeout.description: Maximum wait time per script run. Range: 100-10000 ms.

protocol.title: APP Script I/O Contract
protocol.description: Each script receives one JSON line from stdin and should return plain text or JSON on stdout.
protocol.tip: Use stage to branch logic for transcription-stage and post-process-stage scripts. Non-zero exit, timeout, or invalid output will fall back to original text.

templates.title: Default Templates
templates.description: Restore built-in script templates for this stage.
templates.hint: Restore overwrites current template files and syncs stage script paths.

test.title: Script Test
test.description: Run one manual script call for ASR or post-processing stage and inspect the real output.
test.defaultInput: First, control sugar. Second, sleep early. Third, keep exercising.
test.defaultInputAsr: Well, first, control sugar. Second, sleep early. Third, keep exercising.
test.defaultInputLlm: First, control sugar. Second, sleep early. Third, keep exercising.
test.inputPlaceholder: Type any sample text to test script replacement...

prompts.title: Prompts

selectedPrompt.title: User Prompt & Templates
selectedPrompt.description: Select a template for refining transcriptions or create a new one. Use ${output} inside the prompt text to reference the captured transcript.

prompts.promptInstructionsPlaceholder: Write the instructions to run after transcription. Example: Improve grammar and clarity for the following text: ${output}
prompts.promptTip: Tip: Use ${output} to insert the transcribed text in your prompt.
prompts.selectToEdit: Select a prompt above to view and edit its details.
prompts.createFirst: Click 'Create New Prompt' above to create your first post-processing prompt.

history.title: History
history.empty: No transcriptions yet. Start recording to build your history!
history.deleteError: Failed to delete entry. Please try again.
history.retranscribeError: Failed to re-transcribe. Please try again.
history.transcriptionFailed: Transcription failed. You can re-transcribe using the retry icon.

logDirectory.title: Log Directory
logDirectory.description: Location where log files are stored

updateChecks.label: Check for Updates
updateChecks.description: Automatically check for new versions of Handy

soundTheme.label: Sound Theme
soundTheme.description: Choose a sound theme for recording start and stop feedback

historyLimit.title: History Limit
historyLimit.description: Maximum number of history entries to keep

recordingRetention.title: Auto-Delete Recordings
recordingRetention.description: Automatically delete old recordings to save space

alwaysOnMicrophone.label: Always-On Microphone
alwaysOnMicrophone.description: Keep microphone active for faster response

clamshellMicrophone.title: Clamshell Microphone
clamshellMicrophone.description: Microphone to use when laptop lid is closed

postProcessingToggle.label: Post Processing
postProcessingToggle.description: Enable AI-powered text refinement after transcription

appendTrailingSpace.label: Append Trailing Space
appendTrailingSpace.description: Add a space after pasted transcription

keyboardImplementation.title: Keyboard Implementation
keyboardImplementation.bindingsReset: Keyboard shortcuts were incompatible and reset to defaults

pasteDelay.title: Paste Delay
pasteDelay.description: Delay before sending paste keystroke (in milliseconds). Increase if wrong text is being pasted.

recordingBuffer.title: Extra Recording Buffer
recordingBuffer.description: Extra time (in milliseconds) to keep recording after you release the key, to capture trailing audio. 0 = no extra buffer.

appDataDirectory.title: App Data Directory
appDataDirectory.description: Location where Handy stores its data

whisper.title: Whisper.cpp
whisper.description: High-performance inference of OpenAI's Whisper automatic speech recognition model
whisper.details: Handy uses Whisper.cpp for fast, local speech-to-text processing. Thanks to the amazing work by Georgi Gerganov and contributors.

footer.portableUpdateMessage: Portable installs cannot be updated automatically. To update: download the latest NSIS installer from GitHub Releases, install it to the same folder, then copy your Data/ folder (settings, models, recordings) from the old version to the new one.

accessibility.permissionsDescription: Handy needs accessibility permissions to type transcribed text.

micPermissionDenied.generic: Microphone access was denied by the operating system. Please grant microphone permission in your system settings.
micPermissionDenied.windows: Enable microphone access in Settings → Privacy & security → Microphone (including desktop app access).
micPermissionDenied.macos: Grant microphone access in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone.
micPermissionDenied.linux: Grant microphone access in your system's sound or privacy settings.

errors.noInputDevice: No audio input device was detected. Please connect a microphone or headset and try again.

appLanguage.title: Application Language
appLanguage.description: Change the language of the Handy interface
